chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Abi Jamila, from Muhammad al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
'The fitrah of God upon which He has created the people'
He said: 'He created them upon Tawhid.'

key_terms.التوحيد: Tawhid — the doctrine of Divine Unity, the affirmation that God is One without partners or equals
key_terms.فطرة: Fitrah — the primordial, innate nature that God instilled in every human being at creation, predisposing them toward recognition of the Divine

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by the fitrah of Allah in surah al-Rum 30:30?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides commentary on Quran 30:30, explaining that the 'fitrah of Allah' — the primordial nature upon which all humans are created — means they are created with an innate disposition toward Tawhid (Divine Unity). This hadith establishes that monotheism is not merely taught but is written into the very fabric of human nature, making it the default spiritual state of every human being. The Imam's explanation affirms that deviation from Tawhid is a corruption of the original God-given nature.
